title: CmdPal JS/TS Extensions - Phase 1: TypeScript SDK

proposed_comments.title: Do not finalize before the initialize request can receive its error
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not finalize before the initialize request can receive its error

**Severity:** `high`

`reportFatal` only sets `process.exitCode`, while provider initialization can reject before the host sends `initialize`. The runtime has no guaranteed shutdown sequence that preserves the first request, so the host can wait indefinitely for the initialize error response.

Defer fatal finalization until at least one inbound message is processed, serialize it behind the message queue, and pause stdin only after the queued initialize request produces its response. Keep EOF and dispose shutdown idempotent.

**Verification:** Reject provider creation before the first request and verify one framed initialize error is emitted before exit; run initialization and disposal tests.

confidence.rationale: The current implementation only assigns exitCode on early initialization failure and has no queued finalization before input.

proposed_comments.title: Launch URLs without an unhandled shell child
proposed_comments.body:
### Launch URLs without an unhandled shell child

**Severity:** `high`

The Windows path starts `cmd.exe`, and every detached child is unreferenced without an `error` listener. A launcher failure can become an uncaught child-process error, and routing a user-controlled URL through a shell adds unnecessary parsing.

Use the Windows URL protocol handler directly, such as `rundll32.exe url.dll,FileProtocolHandler <url>`, and attach an error handler before `unref()` on every platform. Log a concise URL-free failure.

**Verification:** Test launcher argument construction, simulate a child error event, and confirm the process remains alive while logging once.

confidence.rationale: The current code invokes a shell and lacks child error handling; both are corrected and tested in the converged fork.

proposed_comments.title: Keep rejected icon URLs out of error payloads
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep rejected icon URLs out of error payloads

**Severity:** `medium`

A non-success response includes the complete URL in the thrown error. Query strings commonly contain access tokens, so this can leak credentials into stderr or a JSON-RPC error.

Keep the HTTP status and status text but replace the interpolated URL with a fixed URL-free message. Add a token-bearing query regression that asserts the URL is absent.

**Verification:** Run the icon helper tests and verify rejected error text contains no path, query, or fragment from the requested URL.

confidence.rationale: The current error directly interpolates the full caller-supplied URL, including query credentials.
